content.overview: Directors are appointed under s. 152, must obtain a DIN under s. 153, and vacate office on the grounds in s. 167.
content.glance: Directors are appointed under s. 152, must obtain a DIN under s. 153, and vacate office on the grounds in s. 167.
content.study: First directors are those named in the articles. Subsequent appointment is by members. Retirement by rotation applies to public companies. Additional and alternate directors are board appointments under s. 161 with member confirmation as stated. A director must give consent and the appointment is filed. Vacation includes the s. 164 disqualification, absence from all board meetings for twelve months without leave, and acting in contravention of s. 184.
